description: Source code for the BMA280 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, data fetching, and conversion functions.

methods.name: bma280_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data (accelerometer and temperature) from the BMA280 device.

methods.name: bma280_channel_accel_convert
methods.description: Converts raw accelerometer data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: bma280_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves specific sensor channel data (accelerometer axes or temperature).

methods.name: bma280_init
methods.description: Initializes the BMA280 sensor device, including configuration and setup.
